propositions: Impact-present ticket close commit discovery performs a full tracker-root os.listdir for every unique historical 8-hex short-id and generic-prefix candidate reference, scaling O(unique_candidates × tracker_size).

The alias-index fix (commit 5c64deff) bounded only the alias branch; short-id and prefix branches in resolve_ticket_id still call os.listdir once per candidate, leaving residual history×tracker scaling.

Referencing commits with 80 distinct non-alias candidates over a 5,351-ticket tracker resulted in 82 tracker-root directory scans (1 build + 80 per-candidate), dominating the 25-62 minute observed close time.

The fix replaces per-candidate resolution with a single ResolverScanIndex built once, using sorted directory names and bisect-based prefix matching to resolve short-id and generic-prefix candidates without repeated full-store walks.

After the fix, the same 80 non-alias candidates were resolved with 1 tracker-root scan instead of 82, with target commit credit and all reference forms (full, short-id, alias, Jira, four-digit, trailer, subject-prefix) semantically unchanged.
